title: RetailAnalytics AdSpendStoreSales

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the retail analytics research task. Conducted comprehensive analysis of store-month panel data covering 200 stores over 3 years. Analyzed the RET-ADV-ROLL policy (2.76% ad-to-sales ratio), evaluated advertising effectiveness, identified seasonal patterns, segmented stores by performance, and developed budget optimization recommendations. Created hybrid allocation strategy (70% current policy + 30% performance-based) with detailed monthly budget plan totaling $33.9M annually. Generated 15 visualizations and comprehensive research report with methodology, results, and recommendations.
